        <api_name>x_938076_now_utils.MSS_Treasury_XMatter_ITID_WidgetFailureHandler</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>The script Include has a function which calls the HSBC Event API to create events into the ServiceNow ITID Instance for Treasury widget failure scenarios.</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>MSS_Treasury_XMatter_ITID_WidgetFailureHandler</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var MSS_Treasury_XMatter_ITID_WidgetFailureHandler = Class.create();
MSS_Treasury_XMatter_ITID_WidgetFailureHandler.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},
    createITIDEvent: function(severity, text, object) {
        try {
            var parm2 = object + '|' + severity;
            gs.eventQueue('x_hsb11_mss_tsd.Treasury_Send_ITID_Alert', current, text, parm2);
        } catch (error) {
            gs.error("Treasury - Script Include - MSS_Treasury_XMatter_ITID_WidgetFailureHandler Unknow Error: " + error.message);
        }

    },
    type: 'MSS_Treasury_XMatter_ITID_WidgetFailureHandler'
};]]></script>
